title: discovery/scan/verify_loop prune skip-dirs by ABSOLUTE path parts: a project under any build/dist/target/vendor/worktrees ancestor discovers nothing
detail: discovery._iter_source_files (IGNORE_DIRS), scan's walker (_SKIP_DIR_NAMES) and verify_loop's test search test 'part in SKIP for part in p.parts' on the absolute path, so an ancestor of the project root named worktrees/build/dist/target/vendor prunes EVERY file: the dep-graph is empty, blast radius is empty, scan says 'no scannable files', and nothing errors. Seen running the engine suite inside worktrees/solo: test_scan (4) and test_python_from_import_edges oracle (0 importers) fail. Fix: test the parts relative to the walk root.
